name: GospelChannel Church Finder
tagline: Find Christian churches by worship style, denomination, language, and location
description: Read-only remote MCP from GospelChannel, a free global church guide. Search churches near a place or in a named city, filter by worship style (contemporary, gospel, charismatic, traditional), denomination, and service language, and open a full church profile with website, worship music, and recorded service times. Free, no authentication, Streamable HTTP.
